_readme: Copy this file to the ROOT of a FM-Web-Studio repo as `.showcase.json` and delete the keys you don't need. It is the only thing the portfolio needs from a repo: syncStudioSites.mjs reads it on every sync, so editing it here updates the portfolio with no code change. Every field is optional - a repo with no manifest still appears, using its GitHub homepage field or its .firebaserc to find the live url.
